observations.content: Inspected /home/coder/.pi/web-search.json: exaApiKey (36 chars) and jinaApiKey (65 chars) both present; fetchRouting has 2 providers with allowRemoteHostedProviders=True, confirming the old agent had filled both keys correctly.

Retested web_search with provider=exa and fetch_content mode=readable; both worked with real results, concluding the morning's 'Exa quota exhausted' and 'readable needs key' findings were stale (temporary quota exhaustion, not missing keys).

Verified park-timeout behavior: child agent asker-park asked, got no reply for 10s, parked with 'Parked. Waiting for main agent's reply to start my next turn.' and ended its turn; main replied with code word MANGO-77, which resumed it as a new turn and it reported MANGO-77 exactly. Park-timeout PoC PASSED.

First interrupt attempt failed: scout slow-counter (id 151c7540-793c-4a8b-9a0d-f63202216ab3) counted lines via grep and finished in ~30s (6 files, total 2,974 lines) before the 45s sleep completed, too fast to interrupt.

Spawned worker sleeper (id 9ab5f31f-abb6-4ed6-8d3d-ea52b8b7da16) tasked to run 'sleep 90 && echo SLEEP_DONE' via safe_bash; after 30s sent message_subagent with interrupt:true telling it to reply INTERRUPTED-OK and stop.

Interrupt PoC PASSED: worker sleeper's in-flight turn and sleep were aborted with System Error 'This operation was aborted (stopReason=error, model=cli-openai/zaicp/glm-5.3)', then the replacement prompt ran as a new turn and returned INTERRUPTED-OK exactly.
All three Paseo channel semantics verified E2E: absorb (PINEAPPLE-42), park+resume (MANGO-77), and interrupt (INTERRUPTED-OK).

Confirmed visual-tools and web-fetch extensions carry their own node_modules plus package.json and lockfiles (visual-tools depends on @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli which pulls aws-sdk; web-fetch depends on readability/linkedom/turndown), so duplicating them as dev twins would waste hundreds of MB; md-log.ts is a standalone dependency-free file.

Wrote extensions/README.md (1934 bytes) documenting two-tier layout: tier 1 has dev copies in extensions/ (subagent-types, snip, quiz, ask-user-question, observational-memory) synced to .pi/extensions/ via cp after bun test; tier 2 is live-only packages (visual-tools, web-fetch, md-log) edited in place with origin noted in each file header; notes that every extension traces to an upstream repo, none 'born from thin air'.

Archived the three PoC test agents via paseo_archive_agent (asker-park 5cd46180-4927-4087-8371-1e3db85a8b0b, slow-counter 151c7540-793c-4a8b-9a0d-f63202216ab3, sleeper 9ab5f31f-abb6-4ed6-8d3d-ea52b8b7da16); all three returned success.

Assistant gave final summary closing all three user requests: PoC interrupt+park-timeout both PASS, keys present and working, dev-copy origins traced and layout documented in extensions/README.md; stated no open items remain.

User asked final verification question in Vietnamese: whether all PoCs are OK, whether using all tools/skills/extensions has no errors, no notable issues, no missing/duplicates, and whether test cases sufficiently cover all cases.

Ran quick gap tests: write overwrite works (old 34-byte content replaced with new 69-byte content and read back), and grep with ignoreCase:true matched both 'searchme lower' and 'SEARCHME upper' (2 matches with flag vs 1 without).

Tested fetch_content mode=answer on example.com: worked, returned 'Not found on page. The page has no main heading—only body text about the example domain' with source attribution, proving the extraction+model answer pipeline works.

Found OM consolidation produced durable topic files under /home/coder/workspaces/learn/.memory/01a0522e-81f4-7311-8ba4-027cea97e974/.memory/: INDEX.md, JOURNEY.md and 8 topic files (workspace-and-environment, extension-provenance, paseo-bugs, user-preferences, message-main-bug, tool-test-results, observational-memory, and more); earlier find at maxdepth missed them due to nesting depth; OM observe-to-consolidate lifecycle verified E2E today.

cat of the INDEX.md at that path returned 'No such file or directory' (path discrepancy), but message-main-bug.md read fine with frontmatter (id, title, summary, updated 2026-08-30 12:41) detailing the confirmed message_main queue-flush bug, root cause being paseo-channel.ts self-deadlock via status polling, with a user quote at 10:59 that 'the subagent message delay IS a bug'.

Assistant noted remaining genuinely-untested items in an internal audit: write overwrite (now closed), grep ignoreCase (now closed), fetch_content answer mode (now closed), plus web-fetch PDF/Jina-fallback paths, fetch_content video/YouTube frames, spawn_subagent guided-choice flow (needs user), depth-2 worker-spawns-scout E2E, /om:compact and /om:consolidate slash commands (user-side), md-log activation (user-side /md-log), real scanned PDF for pdf-reader, and live teach-skill flow.
